calculation_steps: Build exact B1,B2 on K4 and projectors PL=B1^TB1/4, PT=B2B2^T/4, verify exact complementary rank3 projectors and B1B2=0.
Add external source action A0 int[p.a'-H0+a.f-psi.(B1p-rho_ref)] ds with rho_ref'=B1f. Vary and derive a'=Up+B1^Tpsi,p'=-vB2B2^Ta+f,rho'=B1f.
Under a->a+B1^Tchi,psi->psi+chi', action changes only boundary A0[chi^T rho_ref] when rho_ref'=B1f. Show H0'=(Up)^T f for any psi.
For zero-sum j, fL=B1^Tj/4 has B1fL=j and PTfL=0; for cycle w with B1w=0, fT=wF has no vertex charge.
For dipole rho=r(1,-1,0,0), H_C=uLr²/4; physical Vdiff=A0uLr/(2tauq0) and Cdip=2tauq0²/(A0uL).
For neutral cycle alpha'=uT beta, beta'=-4v alpha+F(s), derive H_T(T)=uT/2 |int exp(-iomega s)F(s)ds|² and rectangular sinc².
Map Phi=A0a/q0, Q=q0p, E=A0H0/tau, Vedge=A0Up/(tauq0), I=q0 f/tau and verify dE/dt=Vedge^TI.
Exhibit h>0 family U->hU,v->v/h,a->ha,A0->A0/h,psi->hpsi, showing physical Q,Phi,Cinv,Linv and all time-domain responses exactly unchanged.
Compare standard reciprocal multiport LC baseline with same tensors; no independent unique UD physical signature.

counterexamples_and_failures: Same physical reciprocal LC multiport arises from an arbitrary h>0 continuum of native U,v,A0 and a variables; measured linear port response cannot pick native units.
Equal integrated cycle-current pulse can leave zero or positive stored energy depending on pulse timing; charge transferred not equal radiative excitation.
Purely longitudinal balanced charge drive generates no neutral cycle, while neutral cycle current has no vertex charge.
No isolated positive single electron can appear in closed zero-total vertex charge graph without compensating reservoir/source.
Original field carrier is R12, not native UD active rank14; no full-source equivalence assumed.
